text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek! You did great, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yukino Bijin was pretty good out
there.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I thought she was just a pretty face, but
hey,
maybe she'll actually hold her own
in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin, huh? She sure is cute, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I did it... I finished the race...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Now that's a smile! I need to get a picture!

text_block_list.name: Person with Camera
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Good job, Yuki!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You're someth'n else, Yuki! I remember
you
saying what a big deal it is to win a
Triple Tiara
race...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But now I'm abso-positively certain you
can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
However... there's something I've gotta
tell you
first.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
We might not be able t'see each other
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta buckle down and throw myself
into my
own training too.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna let you leave me behind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're right. We've both gotta work our
heinies
off.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That way, next time I meetcha, we can
both hold
our heads up high!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Right. But don't stop messag'n me on
LANE,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Just lemme go get changed!
choice_data_list: じゃあ、美冬さんを送ってくるから

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You know, I always looked up to Yuki. I
still do...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But you should've see her on the ice.
You'd think
she had wings, the way she
jumped... I was always
so jealous of her,
haha.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
She's always been the cat's meow. She's
my hero.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I was able t'watch her race
today.
Thank you so much for the invite!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Mifuyu's already split!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, at least I got t'talk to her a bit.
She's been
cheer'n me up as long as I
can remember.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It kinda breaks my heart know'n we won't be able t'see each other for a while.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right you are!
choice_data_list: それでも、前に進まないとな
それでも、前に進まないとね

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My classic year's com'n up, which means
I'll be
tak'n on the Triple Tiara soon!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll be watch'n, Mifuyu!
